prompt_en: An intimate late-night convenience-store date photographed from her partner's point of view. An adult woman in her mid-twenties, the photographer's girlfriend, leans toward the lens beside the illuminated entrance of a Japanese neighborhood convenience store. She gives her partner a mock-stern, puff-cheeked pout, her lips parted mid-plea as she asks them to stay beside her a little longer. Her eyes meet the lens; a small involuntary smile lifts one corner of her mouth, betraying how much she enjoys their attention. Her left hand lightly tugs her partner's jacket cuff toward her; the same partner's sleeved forearm enters the lower-left foreground, its loose cuff visibly gathered in her fingers and drawn closer to her shoulder. Her left elbow stays bent beside her torso, her wrist aligned with the reachable cuff, while she stands securely on the pavement and inclines her upper body toward the camera. Her right hand cradles a chilled peach drink against her chest. A cream cardigan and casually tousled hair give the moment an everyday, affectionate feel. Use the first attached image as the scene to refine, and the second attached image, the original portrait, as the sole facial appearance reference, preserving her face outline, eye spacing, nose shape, lip shape, visible adult appearance, and short dark bob with airy bangs while allowing the playful expression. Her face dominates an extreme close-up, the lens roughly 30 cm away; a 24mm-equivalent wide-angle perspective enlarges the nearby cuff and lets the store doorway recede around her. A compact CCD-camera snapshot with soft focus and gentle highlight bloom, on-camera direct flash brightening her face against cooler fluorescent store light. Subtle shadow noise, warm skin, pale cyan reflections, and glowing shelves behind the glass evoke a spontaneous Japanese night stroll, with her expression and the sleeve tug clearly readable through the softness. Place her face just right of center, with the sleeve leading diagonally toward her and a narrow band of illuminated storefront behind her. Vertical 3:4 portrait snapshot. Make the existing mock-stern pout visibly affectionate: gently puffed cheeks, parted lips, and one clearly lifted mouth corner forming a tiny involuntary half-smile. The partner forearm runs diagonally from the lower-left frame edge toward her left shoulder on image-right; her left hand gathers its cuff there, connected to the image-right cardigan sleeve. Her separate right hand holds the peach drink on image-left, with its wrist connected to the image-left cardigan sleeve.
negative_en: plastic-looking skin, distorted fingers, excessive HDR, low resolution, over-processed retouching, cartoon style, broken facial features
